title: docs: retire manifest-deps from the plugin-distribution note, re-point two stale plugin-build checklist negatives, correct the liveness manifest cell
body:
Fixes #27685

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:三处文档对齐 #27679 之后的代码:插件分发设计文档只剩 `bundled` 一种打包策略;cli 检查清单条目的两条过期否定句改指向真正做校验与分发的代码;liveness README 的 `manifest` 单元格改正 dead 集合(19 → 与生成分片一致的 13)并补上 `packaging` 为何是 `planned` 的一句。
- 为什么改:`manifest-deps` 已被移除并按名拒收,文档却仍把它写成可选策略;检查清单仍说「解包时无人复核 integrity」「无人按 runtime 分发」,而 #27123 的前两片已经实现了这两件事;README 的手写计数早已过期。
- 风险与回滚:纯文档,无代码、无 schema 改动;`packages/spec/liveness/README.md` 随 npm 包发布,故带一个 `@objectstack/spec` patch changeset。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json`(两条否定句与 revision 5 历史条目)、`packages/spec/liveness/README.md`(`manifest` 行的 dead 集合句)、`docs/design/plugin-distribution.md` §4.3。
- 两分钟验证:`grep -rn "manifest-deps" docs/design/plugin-distribution.md docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json packages/spec/liveness/README.md`,预期只剩「已退役、按名拒收」的叙述,不再有把它当现行策略的句子。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`docs/design/plugin-distribution.md`.** The artifact tree no longer lists `package.json` / `pnpm-lock.yaml`; the compiled-manifest sentence gives `packaging` as `bundled` alone; §4.3 is rewritten as "Packaging strategy: bundled only" with one dated note (in the file's existing note shape, as in §4.2) saying `manifest-deps` was retired and is refused by name (#27679, ADR-0025 v2 §3.3); the publish-time tier gate no longer names `manifest-deps`; §6 step 5 says no dependency install runs at materialize. One same-class line beyond the claim's list: §8's supply-chain bullet named a lockfile and `--ignore-scripts`, both of which existed only for the retired strategy, so it now says no install-time package manager runs at all. Same file, same defect class, mechanical.
- **`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json`, `cli.plugin-manifest-build-contract` only** (revision 4 to 5, history entry added). The integrity and trust-tier ⛔ negatives said nothing re-verifies the map at unpack and nothing dispatches on `runtime`. Both are false since slices 1 and 2 of #27123. Each negative now names the code that does it as the check this item does NOT score: `packages/cli/src/commands/plugin/install.ts#PluginInstall` through `packages/core/src/security/plugin-artifact-integrity.ts#verifyIntegrity`, and `packages/runtime/src/installed-plugin-loader.ts#dispatchPluginRuntime`. The tracker numbers they cited (#11331, #11330) answer 404 in this repository and are gone from the negatives. Three source rows are added for that code. Scored clauses and steps are unchanged.
- **`packages/spec/liveness/README.md`, the `manifest` cell only.** "Dead 19" was a hand-typed count, and it was stale. It counted the seven per-child rows of `capabilities` / `configuration` instead of their two tombstone rows, and a `loading` row that left the ledger with #26599. The cell now partitions the dead set the ledger holds (ten `contributes` members, plus the three retired containers at one row each) and says it sums to 13, the count in the generated `state-counts/manifest.md` shard. It also gains the missing sentence for `packaging`, the type's only `planned` row.
- **`.changeset/27685-manifest-liveness-cell.md`**: `@objectstack/spec` patch. `liveness` is in the package's `files`, so the README ships.

## Tests

No code changed, so no unit tests were added and none were run. Nothing was ablated, because no tested behaviour moved.

## Acceptance notes

- Item 4 of the card (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/marketplaceApi.ts:171`) is untouched, per triage 6504381957. It rides the next `domain:ui` PR there.
- Not edited, recorded here, no card (stale prose, no reach): `docs/adr/0025-plugin-package-distribution.md` still names `manifest-deps` as live at L159 (the manifest example comment), L267 (§3.5 step 5) and L595–596 (the consequences bullet), while its own §3.3 retires it. The ADR is a governed surface and outside this card.
- Not edited, outside this card's passages: `plugin-distribution.md` says the bundle is built with `tsup` (§4.1 tree, §5 step 1). The build uses esbuild (`packages/cli/src/commands/plugin/build.ts`; ADR-0025 v2 §3.3 says the same). §4.3 as rewritten names no bundler.
- Coverage observation, no card: no platform-checklist item scores the install-time integrity refusal or the boot-time tier dispatch. The two re-pointed negatives now name that code as unscored here.

## Verification

H3: the count is generated, not hand-kept. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:liveness-counts` exited 0 and rewrote 0 shards, and the committed `state-counts/manifest.md` already reads dead 13 / planned 1. Only the README prose was stale, so it was corrected from `liveness/manifest.json`, and no number was typed into the shard.
